name: delivery
description: Agent skills for app releases, social posts, YouTube uploads, and web and AWS deployments.

interface.shortDescription: Agent skills for app releases, publishing, and deployment.
interface.longDescription: Skills for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other compatible agents to release apps, publish videos and social posts, and deploy websites and AWS services. Includes plugins for Codex and Claude Code; other agents can read the skills from a full checkout. Development and testing are primarily done with Codex. Uses your existing tools and accounts, with provider guides and an optional Python helper for recording progress.
capabilities: App Store, TestFlight, Mac App Store, and notarized macOS releases
Google Play testing, review, and staged rollouts
Microsoft Store MSIX and EXE/MSI submissions
Chrome Web Store submissions and updates
YouTube and Shorts uploads and scheduled publication
Website and API deployments, domains, DNS, and TLS
AWS deployments, health checks, and recovery
Build and destination checks before release
Recovery after interrupted uploads or deployments
Release verification and optional local progress records
defaultPrompt: Prepare this app build for its store listing. Check what is ready and what is still missing before submission.
Resume this interrupted upload or deployment. Check what the provider has already completed before retrying.
